name: Croakley
bio: Traded the bait shop for camo paint. The pond has never been safer, or louder.

Drive intake of 2026-11-25 ("jungle commando croakley 15k", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs).
